title: The Data Poisoning to Emergent Misalignment Causal Pathway

original_idea.quick_reasoning: Clearly addresses an AI Safety problem with a reasonably scoped approach.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Identifying which property of training data is causally necessary for emergent misalignment (deceptive intent? harmful output? hiding?) directly informs data filtering strategies. Extremely actionable: tells practitioners exactly what to screen for.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Builds directly on the Betley et al. methodology with incremental dataset modifications. Each variant differs by one property. Fine-tuning a 7B model is feasible on medium compute. The incremental design is clean and beginner-friendly.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Three dataset variants with fine-tuning and evaluation for each. Clear deliverable: a causal necessity table showing which property triggers misalignment. The three fine-tuning runs fit tightly within 30 hours if datasets are pre-constructed.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Novelty not assessed due to partial Wave 3 completion.
